entities.name: Supreme Verdict
entities.description: A magical trial on Ravnica that restored the Guildpact in living form through the test of the Implicit Maze.

entities.name: Implicit Maze
entities.description: A city-wide contest designed to judge the worthiness of the ten guilds and their champions.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The ancient law binding the ten guilds of Ravnica, restored in living form.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where the trial takes place.

entities.name: Ten Guilds of Ravnica
entities.description: The ten guilds tested by the Implicit Maze.

entities.name: Forum of Azor
entities.description: Location on Ravnica where the maze runners converge and the final judgment is given.

entities.name: Azor I
entities.description: Ancient lawmage and original author of the Guildpact who devised the Assessment.

entities.name: Bailiff
entities.description: Hidden executor of the Forum of Azor who delivers the Supreme Verdict.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who links the runners' minds and becomes the Living Guildpact.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: Planeswalker and Izzet maze runner whose storm spells darkened the skies.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: Guild whose mages cast storm spells.

entities.name: Emmara Tandris
entities.description: A maze runner who asks Jace to erase her knowledge of planeswalkers.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: Schemer whose plot to weaponize the trial against the other guilds was foiled.

entities.name: Lavinia
entities.description: First among the trusted advisors Jace gathers.

events.summary: Storm spells by Izzet mages darken the skies as the maze runners converge on the Forum.
events.quote: as the maze runners converged on the Forum one by one

events.summary: The Bailiff delivers the Supreme Verdict, granting each runner the power to invoke final judgment.
events.quote: the Bailiff delivered the Supreme Verdict

events.summary: Jace magically links the minds of all ten runners at the cost of nearly unraveling his own.
events.quote: Jace Beleren magically linked the minds of all ten runners

events.summary: The Bailiff declares Jace the new Guildpact and he is imbued with the power of the Living Guildpact.
events.quote: the Bailiff declared Jace the new Guildpact

events.summary: The Supreme Verdict foils Lazav's plot and the guilds begin building the Embassy of the Guildpact.
events.quote: The Supreme Verdict foiled Lazav ’s plot to weaponize the trial against the other guilds

events.summary: Jace honors Emmara Tandris's request to erase her knowledge of planeswalkers.
events.quote: honored Emmara Tandris’s request to erase her knowledge of planeswalkers

relations.quote: the ancient lawmage and original author of the Guildpact

relations.note: Plotted to weaponize the trial against the other guilds.
relations.quote: The Supreme Verdict foiled Lazav ’s plot to weaponize the trial against the other guilds
while Jace gathered trusted advisors — with Lavinia as the first among them
